Badge

Inline labels, counters and status tags. One hook, data-badge, and its value picks the color. The badge scales with the font size of its parent.

Variants

Default Secondary Contrast Active Pending Failed

1 9 42 1280 99+

A count of zero is hidden with the hidden attribute (nothing between the brackets): [0]

Dots

A badge with no text is a dot. It is decorative, so it is hidden from assistive technology and the text next to it carries the meaning.

  • API operational
  • Webhooks degraded
  • Billing sync offline

In buttons and links

The default, secondary and contrast fills invert on a solid button so they stay visible. Status colors keep their own fill.
